यूथ, i. e. यु + थ,
 I. n. A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, Vikr. d. 110; Pañc. 93, 1.
 II. f. थी, A kind of jasmine, Jasminum auriculatum.
 --Comp.
यूथ-प (vb. 2. पा), m. The leader of a herd, Pañc. 253, 16;
यूथ + शस्, adv. In flocks, gregariously,
यूथिका. i. e. युथी (see यूथ), + क, f. A kind of jasmine, Vikr. d. 109; Ṛt. 2, 25.
+ म् यूथ-पति-सकाश + म्, acc. To the chief of the herd, Pañc. 160, 24.
